convention: exp(i beta z-i omega t), passive Im(neff)>0

loss.scope: signed total Im loss; not necessarily confinement-only

Aeff.scope: Et-only actual physical-domain FE quadrature; no PML

gamma.scope: scalar Kerr approximation; n2 value and applicability source required

D.scope: requires tracked mode and wavelength-step convergence
D.inputs: see original validated postprocess API; no inferred constants

B.scope: identified orthogonal modes of the same spatial family
B.inputs: see original validated postprocess API; no inferred constants

kappa.inputs: see original validated postprocess API; no inferred constants

overlap.expression: eta=abs(integral Et1 dot conj(Et2))^2/(integral abs(Et1)^2*integral abs(Et2)^2)
overlap.scope: Et approximation, not full E/H interface scattering
overlap.inputs: see original validated postprocess API; no inferred constants

ARROW.scope: approximate resonance; formula is not FEM verification
ARROW.inputs: see original validated postprocess API; no inferred constants

V_PCF.scope: finite sampled criterion; not an all-wavelength ESM proof
V_PCF.inputs: see original validated postprocess API; no inferred constants
